Create a comprehensive project brief template for [type of project I typically do — e.g., "a website redesign project," "a marketing campaign," "a consulting engagement"]. This brief will be shared with [who — my team, contractors, the client for approval].
Sections: (1) Project overview — what and why in 2-3 sentences, (2) Objectives — what success looks like (specific, measurable), (3) Scope — what's included and what's explicitly OUT of scope (this prevents scope creep), (4) Target audience — who this is for, (5) Timeline — phases with milestones and deadlines (table format), (6) Budget — total budget and how it's allocated, (7) Team & roles — who's doing what, (8) Deliverables — exactly what will be handed over at the end, (9) Requirements & constraints — technical requirements, brand guidelines, legal needs, (10) Approval process — who signs off and when, (11) Risks — what could go wrong and mitigation plans. Include fill-in-the-blank placeholders throughout.
